My plot is only 0.30 hectares, and a full bag of chemical fertilizer from the agro-dealer costs too much money for such a small piece of land. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last season, and I will put cow manure on the soil before the rains come because I keep animals at home. I will do all the work myself with my children — weeding twice and harvesting when it is ready — and I will not pay for outside workers because cash is too tight this year.
